purpose: Test practical reuse of locally identified persistent material states; no neural novelty or superiority claim
noise_scope: calibration measurements only; shared ideal feedback and observed preparation for every controller

recurrent.selection: minimum isolated normal/20 and friction/10 squared validation error sum

identification.selection: independent minimum isolated normal/friction validation RMSE among both known candidate families; no target-world label

metrics.prediction: position RMSE across 1.2s fully open trajectory after observed 4s prefix
metrics.controller: integral squared position error over all 1.2s including reversal; planner keeps fixed cost

statistics.allocation: alpha_r=0.05/(r*(r+1)); Bonferroni across five two-sided paired tests
statistics.unit: replicate mean, equal weight across all four compositions, both noise conditions and 16 profiles
statistics.interval: paired Student-t CI, df=7, familywise 97.5% across five contrasts
statistics.separate_cells: descriptive; no posthoc selection of a favorable world or noise condition

guards.failed_episodes: retain all metrics and report all guard activations

reference_changes: none; full 2x2 Cartesian assembly of the two existing immutable normal laws and two existing immutable friction laws
scope_limits: synthetic forces on native constrained rigid body
same training distributions do not guarantee local support under new coupling
constant-action finite-horizon planner is not globally optimal

decision.contrast: upper simultaneous CI < 0: advantage; lower > 0: disadvantage; otherwise inconclusive
decision.complete_pattern: all five contrast advantages, no numerical-validity failure, and no guard activation for primary candidate blind_state_id in its open trajectories or any of its planned candidates. Comparator guards are retained reported outcomes, not grounds for excluding them or voiding the primary candidate.
decision.minimum_effect: no posthoc threshold; report absolute/relative effect sizes. Statistical sign alone is not declared substantial engineering value.
decision.partial: retain separately supported contrasts; no claim of full success or universal superiority

numerical_validity.backend_scope: one predeclared clean replicate r1, all 4 compositions and16 profiles; frozen predictions compared with native MuJoCo h1,h2,h4
numerical_validity.failure: report results and mark full technical claim inconclusive; no retuning, dropped episodes or new tolerances
numerical_validity.aggregation: All four r1 compositions must pass; ratios median across each composition's 16 profiles, other limits worst across profiles as appropriate. Summary records worst composition values.

resources.incomplete_policy: retain partial artifacts and explicit incompleteness; do not reduce models/seeds or alter stopping based on outcomes
